name: Marketing App
headline: Marketing App: Next.js Project Management
short_description: This is the visual tool that helps your team to manage any type of project, workflow, or task tracking. Add files, checklists, or even automation: Customize it all for how your team works best. Just sign up, create a board, and you're off! Sign up. it's free!
author: abudusamad

sections.overview:
This is a Next.js application designed for project and workflow management. The application is built with modern web technologies including React and TypeScript, utilizing Next.js for server-side rendering and optimized font loading. It provides a foundation for teams to build custom project tracking and task management features. The codebase is open-source and can be deployed to Vercel or other hosting platforms, making it accessible for teams looking to self-host or extend workflow management capabilities.
Self-hosted project management platform for internal team use
Custom workflow automation and task tracking application
Starting point for building branded project management tools
Learning Next.js with a production-ready project structure
- **Company**: GreenTech Solutions
- **Industry**: Renewable Energy
- **Campaign Goal**: Increase brand awareness and generate leads for new solar panel products.
- **Duration**: 3 months
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/abudusamad/marketing-app`
sections.usage:
```
Create a marketing campaign plan for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] using the marketing-app. Include a project timeline, task assignments, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Ensure the plan incorporates file attachments for reference materials and checklists for task completion. Also, suggest automation features to streamline the workflow.
```
